preconditions.description: The integers n and k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s has length n and consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly length k.
The output string is a prefix of some string formed by repeating a prefix of s (s[:i] for some 1 <= i <= n) enough times and then truncating to length k.
The output string is lexicographically smaller than or equal to any other string of length k that can be obtained by the allowed operations.
